label: CU loop • a batch stops at the first step that fails
query: Fill in the name, set the size to Large, and submit.
notes: Deterministic (scripted-model) case for the `batch` contract: steps run in order and the batch stops at the first one that fails. The Size control here has no option list, so `select` fails; Submit, the step after it, must not run. The name edit before the failure stands. The model then gives up with the reason.

scriptedActions: {"verb":"give_up","reason":"the Size control has no option list"}
